data.long_meaning: Mihai is a Romanian name derived from the Old Romanian word 'Mihaiu', which means 'Who is like God?' or 'The gift of God'. It is also associated with the biblical prophet Micah. The name Mihai carries the meaning “Who is like God?” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mihai usually hope their child will grow to embody who is like god? and live with faith, good character and purpose.
